description:
Send a message or signal to a PubNub channel in real-time. Supports both regular messages and lightweight signals.
      Plain strings are automatically wrapped in a 'text' field. Requires publish and subscribe keys from your PubNub keyset.

channel.description: Channel ID to publish message to

message.description: Message payload (can be any JSON-serializable value or plain string)

publishKey.description: Publish Key that can be obtained from your keyset by manage_keysets tool with parameter operation list or in PubNub admin portal

subscribeKey.description: Subscribe Key that can be obtained from your keyset by manage_keysets tool with parameter operation list or in PubNub admin portal

type.description: Type of message to publish: 'message' for regular messages or 'signal' for lightweight signals

name: send_pubnub_message
title: Send Message or Signal to PubNub Channel
